articles.title_zh: 团结通道：最新数据——2026年8月
articles.summary_zh: 欧盟委员会交通与运输总司发布2026年8月团结通道最新数据。自2022年5月启动以来，该通道通过铁路、公路和内河航运维持乌克兰进出口。2026年8月，通道承担乌近100%进口、约95%非农产品出口和约90%粮食油籽出口。累计出口约2.35亿吨货物，进口约1.13亿吨，贸易总额约3140亿欧元。文件强调改善交通管理、简化边境手续及基础设施投资，为乌克兰重建和融入欧盟单一市场奠定基础。
articles.source_name: 欧盟委员会交通与运输总司
articles.content_evidence: In the face of Russia’s war of aggression against Ukraine, the EU, together with Ukraine and Moldova launched the EU-Ukraine Solidarity Lanes in May 2022, establishing new transport routes to keep Ukraine’s imports and exports flowing via rail, road and inland waterways. Today, the EU-Ukraine Solidarity Lanes have become a lifeline for Ukraine’s economy. In August 2026 the Solidarity Lanes allowed: - Nearly 100% of Ukrainian imports - Around 95% of Ukrainian exports of non-agricultural products (in comparison to around 5% through the Black Sea) - Around 90% of Ukrainian exports of grain, oilseeds and related products (in comparison to around 10% through the Black Sea) Ukrainian exports Since May 2022, the Solidarity Lanes have allowed Ukraine to export ca. 235 million tonnes (Mt) of goods, according to data from the Ukrainian customs registers. articles.title_zh: 印度发布商用车BS-VII排放标准草案
articles.title_original: India releases draft BS-VII emission standards for commercial vehicles
articles.summary_zh: 印度公路运输与公路部（MoRTH）提出修订1989年中央机动车规则第115条，纳入商用车Bharat Stage VII（BS-VII）排放标准，限值与Euro 7/VII一致并包含PN10。轻型商用车（N1）自2030年4月1日起适用，卡车和客车（N2、N3、M2、M3）自2031年4月1日起适用，均分三阶段实施：轻型车为2030、2032、2035年4月1日，重型车为2031、2033、2035年4月1日。各阶段逐步引入RDE、OBD、OBM、OBFCM、制动颗粒、电池耐久及轮胎磨损等要求。
articles.content_evidence: news: India releases draft BS-VII emission standards for commercial vehicles India releases draft BS-VII emission standards for commercial vehicles 15 October 2026 India’s Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH) has proposed amendments to Rule 115 of the Central Motor Vehicles Rules, 1989 to include Bharat Stage VII (BS-VII) emission standards for commercial vehicles. Emission limits for these standards are consistent with Euro 7/VII including PN10. Standards for light commercial vehicles would apply April 1, 2030, and those for trucks and buses April 1, 2031. Requirements for all vehicles are introduced over three phases. Please log in to view the full version of this article ( subscription required). Light Commercial Vehicles For all N1 vehicles manufactured on or after April 1, 2030, the three phases start April 1, 2030, April 1, 2032, and April 1, 2035. For Phase-I effective April 1, 2030, RDE testing applies at type approval and OBD , OBM and OBFCM data is to be available

evidence_quotes: India’s Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH) has proposed amendments to Rule 115 of the Central Motor Vehicles Rules, 1989 to include Bharat Stage VII (BS-VII) emission standards for commercial vehicles.
Standards for light commercial vehicles would apply April 1, 2030, and those for trucks and buses April 1, 2031.
For all N2, N3, M2 and M3, vehicles manufactured on or after April 1, 2031, the three phases start April 1, 2031, April 1, 2033, and April 1, 2035.
